title: CARE for Women
desc: This report presents a practical roadmap to close critical gaps in women’s care delivery. Women spend 25% more of their lives in poor health than men, with one-third of this gap caused by preventable failures in care Drawing on the expertise of more than 20 leaders from across the healthcare ecosystem, three high-impact clinical pathways are identified, where targeted interventions could drive meaningful change. The report also introduces the CARE framework, a comprehensive approach for stakeholders to Conduct research, Align care, Report using clear standards and Engage patients. This actionable framework empowers stakeholders to drive better outcomes for women, families and societies worldwide.
